# Routing intent

The routing intent of a Virtual WAN hub (`Microsoft.Network/virtualHubs/routingIntent`): which traffic the
hub sends to a next hop, usually the hub's Azure Firewall. Each routing policy is keyed by its name and
takes one destination, `Internet` or `PrivateTraffic`: a hub has at most one policy of each kind.
`replace_triggers` replaces the routing intent together with its next hop. The root module creates it for a firewall in a
virtual hub (`virtual_hub.routing_intent`); it can also be called on its own with the hub's ID and a next
hop.

Writes are serialised on the hub (`locks`), because Azure refuses parallel writes to one hub's children
(`AnotherOperationInProgress`), which the default `retry` also covers. A hub has one routing intent.

## Required Inputs

The following input variables are required:

### <a name="input_name"></a> [name](#input\_name)

Description: Name of the routing intent. A hub has one.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_parent_id"></a> [parent\_id](#input\_parent\_id)

Description: Resource ID of the Virtual WAN hub.

Type: `string`

### <a name="input_routing_policies"></a> [routing\_policies](#input\_routing\_policies)

Description: Routing policies, by policy name, for example `{ InternetTraffic = { destinations = ["Internet"], next_hop_id = <firewall ID> } }`. A hub has at most one Internet and one private traffic policy (Microsoft Learn); Azure prescribes no names (Learn's examples use `PublicTraffic` and `PrivateTraffic`).

- `destinations` - One destination: `["Internet"]` or `["PrivateTraffic"]`, each in one policy only.
- `next_hop_id` - Resource ID of the next hop, usually the hub's Azure Firewall.

Type:

```hcl
map(object({
    destinations = list(string)
    next_hop_id  = string
  }))
```

## Optional Inputs

The following input variables are optional (have default values):

### <a name="input_ignore_body_changes"></a> [ignore\_body\_changes](#input\_ignore\_body\_changes)

Description: Paths in the routing intent's `body` whose changes the AzAPI provider ignores. Prefer Terraform's `lifecycle.ignore_changes` when the paths are static; use this variable when the paths must be derived from variables or other non-static values.

Paths use dot notation, for example `properties.routingPolicies`. Individual list items cannot be targeted; ignore the whole list property instead. Configuration changes at an ignored path are **not** sent to Azure until that path is removed from the list. Changes take effect only after an apply, because the value is held in provider-private state.

- `network_virtual_hubs_routing_intent` - Ignored body paths for the routing intent.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_virtual_hubs_routing_intent = optional(list(string), [])
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_replace_triggers"></a> [replace\_triggers](#input\_replace\_triggers)

Description: (Optional) Values whose change replaces the routing intent, for example the next hop's own replacement triggers: a replaced firewall keeps its resource ID, so without them the routing intent would still point at the firewall being deleted. The root module passes the firewall's.

Type: `any`

Default: `null`

### <a name="input_resource_types"></a> [resource\_types](#input\_resource\_types)

Description: Override the AzAPI `<provider>/<resource>@<api-version>` string used by this module. The key defaults to a tested value.

- `network_virtual_hubs_routing_intent` - The routing intent.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    network_virtual_hubs_routing_intent = optional(string, "Microsoft.Network/virtualHubs/routingIntent@2025-07-01")
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_retry"></a> [retry](#input\_retry)

Description: Retry configuration applied to the `azapi` resource. Defaults retry `AnotherOperationInProgress`, which Azure returns while another write to the hub runs; any field can be overridden.

- `error_message_regex`  - (Optional) A list of regex patterns matching error messages that trigger a retry. Defaults to `["AnotherOperationInProgress"]`.
- `interval_seconds`     - (Optional) Initial interval between retries in seconds. Defaults to `30`.
- `max_interval_seconds` - (Optional) Maximum interval between retries in seconds. Defaults to `300`.

See <https://registry.terraform.io/providers/Azure/azapi/latest/docs/resources/resource#retry> for full semantics.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    error_message_regex  = optional(list(string), ["AnotherOperationInProgress"])
    interval_seconds     = optional(number, 30)
    max_interval_seconds = optional(number, 300)
  })
```

Default: `{}`

### <a name="input_timeouts"></a> [timeouts](#input\_timeouts)

Description: Default per-operation timeouts applied to the `azapi` resource. Defaults to `null` (provider defaults). Each value is a Go duration string (e.g. `30m`, `1h`).

- `create` - (Optional) Timeout for create operations.
- `read`   - (Optional) Timeout for read operations.
- `update` - (Optional) Timeout for update operations.
- `delete` - (Optional) Timeout for delete operations.

Type:

```hcl
object({
    create = optional(string)
    read   = optional(string)
    update = optional(string)
    delete = optional(string)
  })
```

Default: `null`
